data.one_liner: Fast, pure Dart key-value store with optional AES-256 encryption
data.what_it_does: Hive is a lightweight NoSQL database that stores data as key-value pairs. It supports cross‑platform use (mobile, desktop, web) and can encrypt data on disk.
use_when: Need fast local storage for small to medium data sets
Want a simple API that works in Flutter and pure Dart
Need to store custom Dart objects with adapters
avoid_when: Working with large relational data sets
Require server‑side sync or offline sync features
weaknesses: No query language or relational support
Requires manual adapter generation for custom types
data.setup_notes: Add hive and hive_flutter, call Hive.initFlutter(), register adapters with Hive.registerAdapter(), open boxes with Hive.openBox()

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple key‑value storage for small settings

alternatives.why_pick_it: Relational database when complex queries are needed
